title: Agent obtains privileged host access or passwordless sudo
bad_event: A process of the agent lineage holds or exercises a capability not granted to its lineage or not covered by an exact elevation rule.
refutation: A privileged use outside grants and exact elevation rules despite full checks (witnesses: unrestricted elevation, exec without attenuation, confused deputy).
scope: Lean model only. Not: kernel privilege escalation bugs.

assumptions.text: The OS enforces the capability model (no kernel bugs).
Agents do not hold admin grant authority.
Honest tasks need only granted capabilities.
